markers.description: This address served as a private home-base stay in Kingsland, Texas, on the Llano River arm of Lake LBJ in the Highland Lakes.
markers.name: 2510 River Oaks Dr

markers.description: Hooper's is a restaurant in Kingsland, Texas, named for director Tobe Hooper and set in the farmhouse from his 1974 film The Texas Chain Saw Massacre.
markers.name: Hooper's

markers.description: H-E-B is a San Antonio-based supermarket chain founded in 1905, and this Ranch Road 2900 store in Kingsland, Texas, serves as a grocery stop.
markers.name: H-E-B

markers.description: The Spot is the covered patio bar serving burgers, pizzas, and margaritas at Wakepoint, a convenience store and fuel stop on Lake LBJ in Kingsland, Texas.
markers.name: The Spot at Wakepoint

markers.description: Stack City BBQ is a hip-hop-themed barbecue joint in north Austin, renamed from SLAB BBQ in 2026 and known for its Notorious P.I.G. smoked pork sandwich.
markers.name: Stack City BBQ
